scope: M1 only: Haste, Giant, Dasher, Archer, Minion, exit and non-interactive floor. Echo, Golem, hazards and destructible environment are excluded.

prompts.blessing_rules_reference_m1: Using the attached style and enemy references, create a text-free landscape pixel-art VFX and icon reference board for exactly two enemy blessings. Haste uses cyan-white stacked chevrons, trailing streaks, narrow lightning silhouette, and fast vibration. Giant uses a red-orange heavy hexagonal rune, expanding thick outline, dust weight, and broad aura. Show each as a large 64x64-readable icon shape, a small overhead icon, an application rune, and an in-world effect on both charger and archer silhouettes. Both remain distinguishable in grayscale by shape. Effects must not cover character bodies or attack telegraphs. Do not include a third blessing, duplicate, echo, purple status, text, labels, letters, numbers, logos, or watermark. Preserve crisp hand-placed pixel art, fixed 3/4 top-down camera, upper-left lighting, restrained palette, and exact character designs from the references.
prompts.telegraph_rules_reference_m1: Using the attached style and exact enemy references, create a text-free landscape pixel-art combat telegraph reference board on a low-contrast blue-gray stone floor for exactly two M1 attacks. Show the coral-red charging knight attack as a thick straight lane with a large arrowhead and the violet piercing archer shot as a thin segmented aiming line with a diamond projectile marker. For each, visually separate warning, locked-direction, execution, and recovery states without words. Shapes must be brighter and clearer than particles and background, readable in grayscale by thickness and line pattern, with clean hard edges. No circular impact attack, no echo, no text, labels, letters, numbers, logos, or watermark. Preserve fixed 3/4 top-down view and upper-left lighting.
prompts.environment_rules_reference_m1: Using the attached style reference, create a landscape pixel-art dungeon environment reference board in fixed 3/4 top-down view. Show a low-contrast blue-gray stone floor base tile, four subtle seamless floor variants, simple wall edges and room corners, the same gold diamond exit in clearly different closed and open visual states, and a few clearly non-interactive rubble decorations. Upper-left light direction. Tile boundaries align cleanly and the environment remains visually quieter than cyan, coral-red, violet, green, gold, and bright attack telegraphs. Original game art only. No hazards, cliffs, traps, destructible pillars, characters, attacks, text, labels, letters, numbers, logos, signatures, or watermark.
prompts.ui_rules_reference_m1: Using the attached style reference, create a landscape pixel-art UI style reference board for a desktop 16:9 action-puzzle game. Show text-free examples of a dark blue-gray nine-slice panel, cyan player health frame and fill, circular dash cooldown frame, exactly two blessing slots using cyan stacked-chevron and red heavy-hexagon silhouettes, enemy health frame, green soul icon with an empty counter frame and no digits, gold exit-state badge, blank keyboard keycap shapes, and simple idle-hover-pressed-disabled button states. Crisp pixel corners, restrained pale-gold trim, strong 64x64 and 32x32 readability, neutral dark presentation background. Original game art only. No third blessing, no purple status, no words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, signatures, or watermark.
